subject: Aurora AI SDK — Redwood runtime SDK partnership & onboarding
body:
From: Lia Chen <lia@aurora-ai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Aurora + Redwood: SDK integration & partner onboarding

Hi Michael,

Hope you're well — I'm Lia, Head of Platform Partnerships at Aurora AI. We've been evaluating Redwood Inference as a core runtime for several of our customers who want turnkey hosting + predictable latency. Aurora provides a lightweight SDK for orchestration, tracing hooks, and prompt-templating that many partners use alongside model endpoints.

We'd love to propose a partner-level SDK integration that:
- Adds a Redwood runtime binding in the Aurora SDK (so customers can choose "redwood" as a runtime)
- Surfaces Redwood traces into Aurora's tracing UI (optional telemetry integration)
- Includes a small prompt-tools adapter so our prompt templates map cleanly to Redwood streaming APIs

Initial asks:
1) Are there recommended endpoints and stable headers you'd like us to use for trace correlation?
2) Any constraints we should know about for streaming vs non-streaming flows (timeouts, SSE semantics)?
3) Would Redwood be open to a joint co-marketing checklist and a short integration guide?

We can put together a short technical spec and a 2-week pilot plan if this sounds interesting. Attaching a rough spec + a sample patch for your engineers to eyeball.

Attachments: aurora-redwood-integration-spec.pdf, aurora-sdk-sample.patch

Thanks,
Lia Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships, Aurora AI
lia@aurora-ai.com
https://aurora-ai.com

---

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Lia Chen <lia@aurora-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora + Redwood: SDK integration & partner onboarding

Thanks Lia — excited to connect. Short answers up front:
- Trace correlation: we have a recommended header X-Redwood-Trace-Id and an optional X-Redwood-Request-Id. We'll include details in a snippet.
- Streaming: Redwood supports chunked streaming (SSE-like) and a websocket-forwarding option for private deployments; main constraints are max idle timeout (default 60s) and recommended chunk size ~4KB for stable perf.
- Co-marketing: yes, we do partner playbooks for ISV integrations; happy to do a joint guide and a joint blog post once the pilot succeeds.

Looping in Marissa (partner engineering lead) and Vanessa (partnerships) to scope the technical pilot and timeline. Marissa — can you review their attachments and propose a mutual action plan? Vanessa — can you own the partner checklist / co-marketing ask?

Best,
Michael
VP, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Lia Chen <lia@aurora-ai.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora + Redwood: SDK integration & partner onboarding

Hi all — reviewed the spec and sample patch. Nice and concise. A few technical clarifications before we commit to a 2-week pilot:

1) Runtime binding model
- Are you expecting a single new runtime module (aurora.runtime.redwood) or a pluggable adapter mechanism where we accept a standardized Transport interface? We prefer the latter (Transport interface) but can support a shim for backwards compatibility.

2) Trace surface area
- We can emit trace IDs in response headers and optionally push spans to an ingestion endpoint. For ingestion: do you need us to push to your collectors, or would you prefer trace IDs only so you can link in Aurora's UI?

3) Auth and token lifecycle
- For hosted Redwood API we recommend short-lived tokens per session for SDKs. Can Aurora support token refresh for long-lived sessions? If customers run in private deployments, what's the expected auth model?

4) Streaming behavior
- We can expose close_event metadata when a stream completes or is truncated. Do you have SDK-level retry expectations for partial streams?

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) — 3 milestones:
A) Week 1: prototype runtime adapter + basic trace header flow (internal demo)
B) Week 2: end-to-end demo (Aurora SDK -> Redwood hosted runtime) with sample prompt templates and streaming enabled; prepare integration guide draft
C) Post-pilot: small co-marketing asset and joint announcement readiness check

I'll take point on A/B and provide a 1-2 page integration spec. Can you please confirm which auth/collector approach Aurora prefers so we can size work? Also asked for a quick code link if available.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partner Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: None in this message (we reviewed Lia's attachments).

---

From: Ethan Ross <ethan@aurora-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Lia Chen <lia@aurora-ai.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora + Redwood: SDK integration & partner onboarding

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear MAP. Short answers from engineering:

- Transport interface: yes, we prefer a pluggable Transport interface. We'll send a small PR that implements the Transport for Redwood (shim).
- Tracing: we'd prefer header-only correlation in the pilot (X-Redwood-Trace-Id) so we don't have to accept span payloads. Later we can evaluate pushing spans via an authenticated collector endpoint.
- Auth: Aurora SDK already supports token refresh for session tokens; for private deployments we can support static API keys or mTLS depending on customer needs.
- Streaming retry: our SDK currently retries idempotent requests; for streaming we rely on resumption tokens — we can add a small helper that resumes where Redwood's streaming last_event_id indicates.

We've pushed a prototype branch: https://github.com/aurora-ai/redwood-integration-prototype (readme + sample patch). Also included a small README with code snippets showing how to set X-Redwood-Trace-Id and attach prompt templates.

We'll align on an internal kickoff: can your engineering team join a 60-minute technical kickoff tomorrow at 10:00am PT? We can share the PR and walk the shim.

Thanks,
Ethan Ross
Senior Engineer, Integrations
Aurora AI

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora + Redwood: SDK integration & partner onboarding

Thanks everyone — quick internal notes and next steps:

- Marissa: please own the Week 1 prototype. Action: create a short PR on our side that validates the Transport interface + sets/echoes X-Redwood-Trace-Id. Target: EOD Wed (2026-09-22).
- Vanessa: draft the partner onboarding checklist and a 1-pager for co-marketing. I can intro to marketing for an eventual announcement.
- Lia/Ethan: confirmed for 10:00am PT kickoff (I'll send calendar invite). Please share any additional test accounts or a minimal runbook for the demo.

I'll add HubSpot deal notes (DEAL-9082) and mark pilot as "partner pilot — integration" with expected trial customers.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Michael Grant
VP, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
